title: VoxelGI Doesn't Recognize Albedo from Visual Shader
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.6 Beta 3

### System information

Windows 11 25H2 RTX 4070ti Ryzen 7700X 32GB RAM

### Issue description

VoxelGI doesn't seem to recognize albedo textures assigned via a Visual Shader. Meshes with a VS shader applied will simply be calculated as white.
This seems to happen regardless of whether the texture is applied via SamplerPort or directly dropped-in and connected to the Albedo port.

An example of a VS material not being treated correctly by VoxelGI:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/92000d52-6182-4df2-9235-a440d1438407)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5f687783-907b-4137-a98d-f829a4ee7175)

The sand material is from one of my projects so it's a little involved, it's designed to replicate detail maps since this feature is a little unapproachable in the Standard Material right now. I tested with Samplerport alone and a direct texture plug-in and all approaches had the same result.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2327ce31-bdf3-4fc2-80de-e3d938f22965)

### Steps to reproduce

MRP attached. You may need to reconnect the texture in the VS since it seems to bug when the .godot folder is deleted to reduce size.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[voxel-gi-no-albedo-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24512167/voxel-gi-no-albedo-bug.zip)
